title: Foley sounds
doc: Named sounds and sound sets (footsteps, voices, impacts) used by entities, weapons, clutter and vclips, plus the impact sound sets of debris.

sections.name: #Entity Sounds
sections.doc: Named sounds; the game finds each entry by searching for the exact text $Name: (case-sensitive) and stops when none is left.

fields.name: $Sounds:
fields.doc: Number of $Sound: lines that follow (1 when omitted).

fields.name: $Material:
fields.doc: Material this sound belongs to (footsteps and impacts); an unknown name stops the game.

fields.name: $Sound:

parts.doc: the sound file; "" means none, and then no numbers follow
distance in metres at which the sound starts to fade

fields.doc: One sound of the set: file, minimum distance and volume.

sections.name: #Custom Sound Sets
sections.doc: Impact sound sets, read by a second pass that searches the file for this header; entries use lower-case $name: so the first pass skips them.

fields.name: $name:
fields.doc: Unique sound set name (clutter $Debris Sound Set: refers to it).

fields.name: +sound:

parts.doc: number of sound rows that follow

fields.doc: Sounds for one material: the material name (or "all") and a count of 1 to 4, then that many unmarked sound rows.

rows.doc: one sound file; "" means none, and then no numbers follow
distance in metres at which the sound starts to fade
